notes.title: Space BloX going FREE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We would like to announce that Space BloX is changing to a free-to-play game. We are working on some other projects and wanted to let Space BloX get into the hands of more retro-minded gamers. Space BloX was created to be an easy game to pick up and play, alone or together. By going free, this will make it even easier and give you another option for those quick multiplayer sessions!

We feel this is the best thing for the game, and we do have some minor updates planned as well. We should have some more news on that coming soon!

The switch is currently in the works, and we will have an update as soon as it's available for everyone to play. Stay safe out there!
